_what: Collected Record Equivalents (CRE), the unit the Commons ETA clock prices collection in. Sam, 2026-11-17 (S678): 1 CRE = one course outline row (an SLO or an objective); one program record = 15 CRE; a record with gaps noted counts in full. Cost per CRE = dollars spent / CREs collected over the same dates. The weights are fixed for Phase 1. A new record type (ASSIST, CCCApply and others) gets its own weight when it arrives, and the weights below never change.

baseline.label: Fable, Nov 11 to 14
baseline.source: Sam, 2026-11-17 (S678), about 21,500 CRE at about $0.15 to $0.34 per CRE
